verdict.rationale: Canny's own documentation says its MCP server lets users "reply to customers" while acting on feedback ideas. That is a first-party reply capability, but it is documented as happening from inside an LLM, not from within the feedback record in Canny's UI. The changelog's "show customers you heard them" adds broadcast-style loop closing, not direct replies. Missing for 10: documentation of replying directly from the feedback record/post in the Canny app, details on how replies reach customers (email, comment, notification), and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reply to customers directly from within the feedback record to close the loop

citations.quote: Move ideas through your workflow without leaving your LLM. Update statuses, link deals, organize requests, and reply to customers.
Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
